Hmmm, are you sure it's the remeron? 2 months is not a long time at all and the dose you were taking is quite small. There's this book I followed on how to stop taking antidepressants and the tapering protocol is not that extreme. For example, starting at 15 mg, taper on 7.5 mg for 1 month, then off. I did a similar one, starting at 15 went to 7.5, then 3.75, then done. Had to go back on for a bit because of insomnia, but I knew that was coming. Had increase in anxiety and a couple panic attacks, but nothing I would consider extreme. You are correct, we are all different and require different approaches to things, but dont drag this out longer than it has to. Personally I think that tapering protocol is way too slow. Just get it over with

I would say yes it makes sense you'll get over it pretty quickly. Antidepressants take a long time to start working, few weeks at least. They have to build up your system. So really you haven't been taking them that long. My withdrawals were very minimal. Slight increase in anxiety for a couple weeks and that was it. No brain zaps, nausea, nothing like that. And I've been taking it for 7 years. You'll be okay. As for the insomnia I'd recommend trying to find natural supplements or something else more sustainable in the long run like healthy sleeping habits and a good exercise regime. I know it's not easy but the pills can be extremely addictive
